description: Rows held out of the renderable citywide set because key fields are missing or unusable (no TDS, no average monthly gross rent, or a parse error). Every raw row is either in developments/tenant_rents or here — nothing is dropped silently. These need better source data from NYCHA before they can appear on the map.

fields.explanation: Open Data lists this development but AVG MONTHLY GROSS RENT is blank. The 2026 PDF also has no rent for this TDS. Source data gap — we need a published rent before a wedge can be drawn.
